Nocturne|jgl.identity: Physical damage fighter-assassin who specializes in long-range dives. Duskbringer (Q) leaves a trail that speeds him up and boosts his damage, Shroud of Darkness (W) blocks an ability and gives him attack speed, Unspeakable Horror (E) tethers a target and fears it if it doesn't get away fast enough, and Paranoia (R) reduces the whole enemy team's vision before he dashes onto a champion. His passive regularly hits in an area and heals him.
Nocturne|jgl.playstyle: Farming jungler who starts diving at level 6. Nocturne turns every ultimate into a potential kill on an isolated carry.
Nocturne|jgl.early_game: Clear fast thanks to your passive, which hits in an area and heals. Gank when a laner can follow up: Q to speed up, E for the fear, W to block the enemy's escape or CC. Farm until 6 if there's no clear opportunity.
Nocturne|jgl.level_2: Shroud of Darkness (W). Blocks an ability: save it for the enemy CC in ganks or duels.
Nocturne|jgl.level_3: Unspeakable Horror (E) or a second Q depending on your path. E tethers and fears: first gank possible.
Nocturne|jgl.level_6: Paranoia: the whole enemy team loses vision, then you dash onto a champion. Use it on an isolated carry or a struggling lane: it's your main pressure tool.
power_spikes: Level 6: Paranoia, dives across the whole map.
First completed item: burst that kills carries.
Mid game: picks on isolated targets.
Nocturne|jgl.jungle_plan: Fast full clear until 6, ganking if an opportunity shows up. After 6, watch the map: every isolated carry is a target for Paranoia. Control Scuttles, Void Grubs (around 8 minutes) and dragons. Use the enemy's loss of vision during your ultimate to take an objective or set up a fight.
Nocturne|jgl.trading: Ganking: Q → E → W to block the CC → attacks. Diving: R onto the target → E → W → attacks. Give up on it if the target is surrounded by allies who can lock you down after your W.
threats: Shyvana, Wukong and Udyr, among the worst matchups according to the data.
mistakes: Casting W too early, with no ability to block.
Diving with your ultimate onto a target surrounded by allies.
Wasting your ultimate without follow-up from your team.

matchup_notes.Lee Sin: Block his Q with W and dive him with your ultimate.
matchup_notes.Graves: He beats you early: wait for your 6.
matchup_notes.Wukong: His clone fools your ultimate: aim for the real one.
matchup_notes.Shyvana: She scales well and soaks your burst: play before she gets strong.

Nocturne|jgl.mid_game: Ultimate dives and objectives. Use the enemy's loss of vision to set up fights.
Nocturne|jgl.late_game: Dive the enemy carry with your ultimate; W to block the incoming CC.
Nocturne|jgl.ahead: Dive isolated carries, take objectives and force fights.
Nocturne|jgl.behind: Farm and look for picks with your ultimate on isolated targets.
Nocturne|jgl.win_condition: To win this game, you want to use Paranoia to kill isolated carries and create advantages across the map.
Nocturne|jgl.final_tip: Save Shroud of Darkness for the enemy CC: it decides whether your dive succeeds.
